[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "treatman"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "TM (TreatMan) - Autonomous Windows AI Agent (JARVIS-like)"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
authors = [
    { name = "TreatMan Project" }
]
dependencies = [
    "httpx>=0.27.0",
    "rich>=13.7.0",
    "pyyaml>=6.0.1",
    "pydantic>=2.7.0",
    "psutil>=5.9.8",
    "send2trash>=1.8.3",
    "ddgs>=9.16.0",
    "mss>=9.0.1",
    "Pillow>=10.3.0",
    "edge-tts>=6.1.12",
    "SpeechRecognition>=3.17.0",
    "comtypes>=1.4.0",
    "keyboard>=0.13.5",
    "pystray>=0.19.5",
    "pywebview>=6.2.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
audio = [
    "pycaw>=20240210",
    "screen-brightness-control>=0.23.0",
    "pyaudio>=0.2.14",
    "sounddevice>=0.4.6",
    "faster-whisper>=1.0.2",
    "openwakeword>=0.6.0",
]
gui = [
    "pyautogui>=0.9.54",
    "pywinauto>=0.6.8",
    "pystray>=0.19.5",
    "keyboard>=0.13.5",
]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.1.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.23.0",
]

[project.scripts]
tm = "run_tm:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["."]
include = ["tm*"]
